title: Localization of normalized integral Roos augmentations
statement: In the geometric and coefficient setting of [def-sfb-integral-pullback-strict-roos-data], fix d, a, e, alphaT, alphaU, alphaV, epsilon, kappaR, jR, kappaC, jC of its specified types, satisfying the ordinary generator, finite-level e, cone-coordinate, scalar-chain and normalized-derived-limit-inclusion conditions of [lem-sfb-integral-roos-chain-representatives]. On flat-term K-flat inputs, alphaU followed by kappaR equals the completed quotient-completion unit followed by derived limit of its reduction counit, and alphaT followed by kappaR and the ordinary pullback counit equals completedPullbackComparison followed by derived limit of towerCounit. Also IsConstantUnitNormalized holds: alphaV, followed by kappaC and derived limit of constantTowerIso, equals the constant quotient-completion unit followed by derived limit of its reduction counit. These are equations before any completion unit is inverted, with no completeness hypothesis. The two other naturality clauses of IsLocalized are not asserted.

proof.text: The normalized cone coordinates fix each alpha uniquely as roosAugment of the corresponding strict quotient augmentation. The normalized ordinary-limit inclusion pins kappa to the universal strict Roos comparison. Its augmentation clause identifies localized alpha with the constant-tower unit followed by derived inverse limit of the augmentation.

Use the resolving-class computation of strict reduction on the ordinary pullbacks. For U this gives the completed quotient unit, and for V transport by constantTowerIso first; its balanced tensor-generator formulas preserve the quotient augmentation. This gives the U and V unit equations.

Exact completed inverse image and its universal derived counit identify the augmented strict source tower with T. The definition of completedPullbackComparison then gives the T identity. The augmented scalar Roos resolution identifies the scalar-restricted augmentation used in the constant coefficient equation.

theorem integralRoosAugmentationLocalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ l)]
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (d : pullR l E g ⋙ res l E X ≅ res l E Y ⋙ pullC l E g)
    (a : T l E g ≅ U l E g)
    (e : T l E g ⋙ towerRes l E X ≅ V l E g)
    (αT : alphaTType l E g) (αU : alphaUType l E g) (αV : alphaVType l E g)
    (ε : EType l E g)
    (κR : kappaType X (R l E X)) (jR : inclusionType X (R l E X))
    (κC : kappaType X (C l E X)) (jC : inclusionType X (C l E X))
    (hd : PulledReduction.IsOrdinaryNormalized (datum l E) g d.inv)
    (ha : IsLambdaNormalized l E g a)
    (he : ∀ (M : ModR l E Y) (n : ℕ), (e.hom.app M).app (op n) =
      d.hom.app (((redR l E Y).obj M).obj (op n)) ≫
        (pullC l E g).map
          (((OrderedExchange.ordinaryRho (datum l E) Y).inv.app M).app (op n)))
    (hα : IsAugmentationNormalized l E g αT αU αV)
    (hε : IsENormalized l E g e ε)
    (hE : ∀ P : complexesR l E Y,
      (cxRes l E X).map (αT P) ≫ (ε P).hom =
        (dComplex l E g d).hom.app P ≫ αV P)
    (hκR : IsUnitNormalized X (R l E X) κR jR)
    (hκC : IsUnitNormalized X (C l E X) κC jC) :
    (∀ (P : complexesR l E Y), GoodR l E Y P →
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (αU P) ≫ κR.hom.app ((cxU l E g).obj P) =
        unitR l E X (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((cxPullR l E g).obj P)) ≫
          (completedRlim X (R l E X)).map
            (completedReductionTowerComplexCounit X (datum l E)
              ((cxPullR l E g).obj P))) ∧
    (∀ (P : complexesR l E Y), GoodR l E Y P →
      completedOrdinaryPullbackComplexCounit g (datum l E) P ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (αT P) ≫ κR.hom.app ((cxT l E g).obj P) =
        completedPullbackComparison g (datum l E) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (completedRlim X (R l E X)).map (towerCounit l E g P)) ∧
    IsConstantUnitNormalized l E g d a e αV κC
